items.listitem: What is a profile?

items.para: *A profile is information about a person that is shown on an online account, such as a username, picture, or short description.*

items.listitem: Why is it safer to use a nickname instead of your real full name?

items.para: *It is safer because a nickname helps protect your identity and personal information from strangers online.*

items.listitem: Why is timing important in animation? Give an example of what might happen if you do not use timing correctly.

items.para: *Timing is important because it controls how fast or slowly actions happen. Without proper timing, an animation may look too fast, too slow, or unnatural.*
**Example:** *If a bird moves too quickly, it may appear to fly unrealistically across the screen.*
